cues: Red oxide is copper one oxide, formed when Fehling's solution is reduced by a sugar, and used in ruby glass and antifouling paint for ships.
Black oxide is copper two oxide, made by heating copper in air, used as a glass pigment and as the oxidant in organic analysis.
text: The two oxides of copper. Red oxide is copper one oxide, formed when Fehling's solution is reduced by a sugar, and used in ruby glass and antifouling paint for ships. Black oxide is copper two oxide, made by heating copper in air, used as a glass pigment and as the oxidant in organic analysis.
